name: Electromagnetism
description: The branch of physics involving the study of the electromagnetic force.

name: Fluid Dynamics
description: The subdiscipline of fluid mechanics that describes the flow of fluids.

name: Acoustics
description: The branch of physics that deals with the study of mechanical waves in gases, liquids, and solids including topics such as vibration, sound, ultrasound and infrasound.

name: Nuclear Physics
description: The field of physics that studies atomic nuclei and their constituents and interactions.

name: Wave Mechanics
description: The study of the physical principles underlying the behavior of waves.
